description: Attention-pattern patching at layer 12 of Llama-3.2-1B: one head at a time, its pattern at the last query position (`attention_probabilities`) is swapped in from the counterfactual prompt and its values are left alone, 32 points, one per head, the head scored as it is read. It asks whether where a head looks carries the day, apart from what it moves. It does not: no head's pattern flips a pair, and head 28, whose result alone moves the answer in head_patching.json, leaves the mean logit diff at -2.40 against a median of -2.40 over the heads. The pattern's last axis is each row's own keys, its tokens in order, so the two prompts of a pair must tokenize to the same length for key k to be the same token in both, which every pair here does (the run checks before any forward). The pattern is inside the attention's forward: it needs `attn_implementation: eager`, nnterp reads it there, and the hooks engine refuses it by name, as an NDIF deployment that runs sdpa does. A GPU run flips no pair either, its logit diffs within about 1e-5 of the CPU's.
